body: I kept the sealed seed packet you asked about. The trial crew passed before breakfast; my brother started coughing, and only later the buses quit running.
title: Before breakfast: sealed seed packet
gloss: A personal trace links trial residue to illness before a later restriction.
rival_reading: A response team could have carried farm supplies while checking exposure; the objects and timing do not establish that the trial caused it.

body:
The first man said they were checking on us. The second asked which neighbors had left and wrote their names before he asked whether they were well.

I told them the little boy next door was with his aunt. He had gone to fetch her because she was alone. When the men returned, they asked me to say that both houses had been empty since noon.

I can say I misunderstood the hour. I cannot explain why they came back to change it.
title: A knock after dark
gloss: A scene-specific count or record was controlled while people were still present.
rival_reading: The same trace could follow an investigation of contaminated farm goods or an ordinary emergency response.
